## Download

- **Windows 10 or 11:** `Heard-Setup-<version>.exe`. The installer isn't code-signed yet, so Windows may say "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
- **macOS 13 or later, Apple Silicon (M1 or newer):** `Heard-<version>-arm64.dmg`. Open it and drag Heard to Applications. The app isn't notarized by Apple yet, so the first time you open it macOS says it can't verify it. Click **Done**, open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, and click **Open Anyway**.

On first launch, add an API key for your AI in Settings. Your first recording downloads the speech model (about 130 MB); after that, transcription works offline.

Once it's installed, Heard looks for new versions itself. On Windows it downloads them and installs them when you restart it. On a Mac it tells you when there's a new one to download.
